alongside.row-label.meaning: Marks a Timeline row whose Behavior can be done alongside other things, and says when that comes from Cadence's guess rather than the person's answer.

alongside.form-guess.meaning: Shows Cadence's guess beside the unanswered alongside setting in the Behavior form, which planning uses until the person answers.
alongside.form-guess.text: Cadence guesses {guess, select, yes {Yes} other {No}}. Planning uses the guess until you choose.

alongside.where-guess.meaning: The Where suggestion line for a Behavior with Where not set, when planning uses Cadence's guess of where it happens.
alongside.where-guess.text: {kind, select, home {Cadence guesses this happens at Home.} anywhere {Cadence guesses this can happen anywhere.} other {Cadence guesses this happens away from home.}} Planning uses the guess until Where is set.

alongside.answer-saved.meaning: Confirms an answer to the alongside question from the Timeline row or the Daily Brief; the Behavior setting now holds it on every surface.
alongside.answer-saved.text: {answer, select, yes {Saved: it can be done alongside other things.} other {Saved: it needs its own time.}}

alongside.answer-not-found.meaning: An alongside answer was refused because the Behavior is no longer in the person's account.
alongside.answer-not-found.text: This Behavior is not in your account anymore.

alongside.answer-changed.meaning: An alongside answer was refused because the Behavior changed while it was being saved.
alongside.answer-changed.text: This Behavior changed just now. Try again.

alongside.answer-unavailable.meaning: An alongside answer could not be saved, because the setting is unavailable or the save failed.
alongside.answer-unavailable.text: Cadence could not save that. Try again.

alongside.brief-question.meaning: The Daily Brief's one question line about a Behavior whose alongside question is open, answered with Yes or No.
alongside.brief-question.text: Can {title} be done alongside other things?
